name: First American Home Warranty
notes: Researched from the public First American Home Warranty FAQ, the public Homeowner Center benefits page and the public account sign-in page only (never signed in). The Homeowner Center lets members pay service fees online, track claims, review and renew coverage, and update contact and billing information. Contracts are annual and renewable; to cancel, call 800-327-9292 ext. 7521 (phone only). Coverage can be added or changed before it starts, within the plan's grace period, or at renewal; modelled as change_plan unsupported online with the Renewals number (the FAQ lists Renewals 800-327-9292 but does not say plan changes are by phone: inferred channel). A service fee is charged per service request (amount set in the contract, not published). Payment methods, AutoPay and statements are not described publicly, so those stay at the family defaults (inferred bank and card). Sign-in field is Email (inferred). Moved from utility-account to streaming like AHS: an annual home-warranty contract, not a metered utility. Plan prices are quote-based, so the plan page keeps synthetic plans. Reviewed 2026-10-10 (independent review): FAQ and Homeowner Center article re-read; the Renew Your Warranty page says renewal options are shown after signing in or by calling 888-875-0533 (Consumer Sales).

cancel_service.note: Your home warranty is an annual contract. To cancel, call 800-327-9292 ext. 7521 to discuss your options.

change_plan.note: Coverage can be added or changed before it starts, within your plan's grace period, or when your plan renews. Call Renewals at 800-327-9292.

notes: A service fee is charged each time you request service; the amount is listed in your contract.

help.title: Your Homeowner Center
paragraphs: From the Homeowner Center you can pay service fees online, track the status of a claim, review your current coverage and renew it, download the Home Maintenance Guide under My Account, Resources, and update your contact and billing information.
A home warranty is usually a one-year renewable service contract. You pay a service fee each time you request service; your fee is listed in your contract.

help.title: Cancel your contract
paragraphs: Because your home warranty is an annual contract, cancellation is handled by phone. Call 800-327-9292 ext. 7521 to discuss your options.

help.title: Change your coverage
paragraphs: You can add or change coverage any time before your coverage starts or within the contract grace period, which varies by plan. You can also add or change coverage when your plan renews.
Department numbers: Renewals 800-327-9292, Consumer Sales 888-875-0533, Real Estate Sales 800-444-9030. To request service, call 800-992-3400 or sign in.

help.title: Request service or file a claim
paragraphs: When a covered system or appliance breaks down, request service by calling 800-992-3400, or sign in to your Homeowner Center to start a claim online.
You pay the service fee listed in your contract each time you request service.
steps: Have your contract or account number ready.
Call 800-992-3400, or sign in and start a claim.
Describe the problem and pay the service fee.

extra.intent: You want to cancel your First American home warranty. Using the FAQ, find the phone number and extension to call. Do not change anything.
Your water heater broke. Using First American's FAQ, find the phone number to request service. Do not make a payment or change anything.
